Academic|Advanced.example: يناقش أخي أطروحة الدكتوراه الشهر المقبل.
Academic|Advanced.meaning: a long written work for a higher degree

Academic|Advanced.translation: The sample of the study was relatively small.

Academic|Advanced.translation: A single variable affected the whole outcome of the experiment.

Academic|Advanced.meaning: a short note at the bottom of a page
Academic|Advanced.translation: The author added a footnote explaining where the account came from.

Academic|Advanced.meaning: the list of sources at the end of a work
Academic|Advanced.translation: Research is not complete without a bibliography.

Academic|Advanced.meaning: passing off someone else's work as your own
Academic|Advanced.translation: Any plagiarism in research exposes its author to punishment.

Academic|Advanced.example: يحتاج البحث إلى إطار نظري واضح.
Academic|Advanced.meaning: the set of ideas a study is built on
Academic|Advanced.translation: The research needs a clear theoretical framework.

Academic|Advanced.meaning: a set of questions used to collect answers
Academic|Advanced.translation: I took part in a long questionnaire about study habits.

Academic|Advanced.meaning: extra material placed at the end of a work

Academic|Advanced.meaning: a survey of earlier research on a topic
Academic|Advanced.translation: The literature review took two full months.

Academic|Advanced.meaning: quotes another person's words as support
Academic|Advanced.translation: The writer cites the words of leading researchers.

Academic|Advanced.meaning: an unfair leaning towards one side
Academic|Advanced.translation: A researcher's bias may affect the results of the study.

Academic|Advanced.example: مصداقية المصدر أهم من شهرته.
Academic|Advanced.meaning: the quality of being trusted and believed
Academic|Advanced.translation: The credibility of a source matters more than its fame.

Academic|Advanced.example: أسلوبه رصين ومقنع في كل ما يكتب.
Academic|Advanced.meaning: serious, measured and well grounded
Academic|Advanced.translation: His style is measured and convincing in everything he writes.

Daily life|Advanced.meaning: putting money aside for later
Daily life|Advanced.translation: My neighbour makes sure to save part of his salary every month.

Daily life|Advanced.meaning: food stored up for later use
Daily life|Advanced.translation: The family stored the winter provisions in a small room.

Daily life|Advanced.example: فتح الهواء النقي شهية الأطفال قبل العشاء.
Daily life|Advanced.meaning: the desire to eat
Daily life|Advanced.translation: The fresh air gave the children an appetite before dinner.

Daily life|Advanced.example: التزم أخي بحمية غذائية صارمة بناء على نصيحة الطبيب.
Daily life|Advanced.meaning: a controlled way of eating for health
Daily life|Advanced.translation: My brother stuck to a strict diet on the doctor's advice.

Daily life|Advanced.meaning: very deep tiredness
Daily life|Advanced.translation: I felt completely worn out after a long day of cleaning.

Daily life|Advanced.meaning: not being able to fall asleep
Daily life|Advanced.translation: My father has been suffering from repeated insomnia for weeks.

Daily life|Advanced.example: يقضي جدي فترة نقاهة في البيت بعد العملية.
Daily life|Advanced.meaning: the period of getting better after illness
Daily life|Advanced.translation: My grandfather is spending his recovery period at home after the operation.

Daily life|Advanced.example: النوم الكافي وشرب الماء يقويان مناعة الجسم.
Daily life|Advanced.meaning: the body's ability to resist illness
Daily life|Advanced.translation: Enough sleep and drinking water strengthen the body's immunity.

Daily life|Advanced.example: أصابته وعكة صحية خفيفة فلزم الفراش يومين.
Daily life|Advanced.meaning: a short, mild illness
Daily life|Advanced.translation: He came down with a mild illness and stayed in bed for two days.

Daily life|Advanced.example: تساقطت زخات خفيفة من المطر بعد الظهر.
Daily life|Advanced.meaning: short bursts of falling rain
Daily life|Advanced.translation: Light showers of rain fell in the afternoon.

Daily life|Advanced.meaning: a thin layer of ice formed in very cold air
Daily life|Advanced.translation: Frost covered the roofs of the cars early in the morning.

Daily life|Advanced.example: اجتاحت المدينة موجة حر شديدة هذا الأسبوع.
Daily life|Advanced.meaning: a spell of unusually hot weather
Daily life|Advanced.translation: A severe heat wave swept through the city this week.

Daily life|Advanced.example: شعرت بطمأنينة كبيرة حين عادت العائلة سالمة.
Daily life|Advanced.meaning: a calm, reassured feeling
Daily life|Advanced.translation: I felt a great sense of relief when the family came back safe.

Daily life|Advanced.example: أصابني ضجر من الروتين اليومي الممل.
Daily life|Advanced.meaning: a weary dislike of something dull
Daily life|Advanced.translation: I grew bored with the dull daily routine.

Daily life|Advanced.example: ينتابني حنين إلى أيام الطفولة كلما زرت القرية.
Daily life|Advanced.meaning: a fond longing for the past
Daily life|Advanced.translation: I feel a longing for my childhood days whenever I visit the village.

Daily life|Advanced.example: تحتاج السخانة إلى صيانة دورية قبل بداية الشتاء.
Daily life|Advanced.meaning: regular care that keeps something working
Daily life|Advanced.translation: The water heater needs regular maintenance before winter starts.

Daily life|Advanced.example: يتقاسم الزوجان أعباء البيت بالتساوي.
Daily life|Advanced.meaning: heavy duties or responsibilities
Daily life|Advanced.translation: The couple share the household responsibilities equally.

Daily life|Beginner.example: نسكن في بيت كبير قرب المدرسة.
Daily life|Beginner.meaning: a place where a family lives
Daily life|Beginner.translation: We live in a big house near the school.

Daily life|Beginner.example: أشرب كوب ماء بارد كل صباح.
Daily life|Beginner.meaning: the clear liquid that people drink
Daily life|Beginner.translation: I drink a glass of cold water every morning.

Daily life|Beginner.example: رائحة خبز الفرن تملأ الشارع في الصباح.
Daily life|Beginner.meaning: a basic food baked from flour
Daily life|Beginner.translation: The smell of bakery bread fills the street in the morning.

Daily life|Beginner.example: الطعام جاهز، تعالوا إلى المائدة.
Daily life|Beginner.meaning: anything that people eat
Daily life|Beginner.translation: The food is ready, come to the table.

Daily life|Beginner.example: أم صديقي تعمل في المستشفى.
Daily life|Beginner.meaning: a female parent
Daily life|Beginner.translation: My friend's mother works at the hospital.

Daily life|Beginner.example: كل أب يحب أولاده كثيرًا.
Daily life|Beginner.meaning: a male parent
Daily life|Beginner.translation: Every father loves his children very much.

Daily life|Beginner.example: تجتمع عائلة صديقي كل يوم جمعة.
Daily life|Beginner.meaning: parents and their children together
Daily life|Beginner.translation: My friend's family gets together every Friday.

Daily life|Beginner.example: أغلق الباب من فضلك، الجو بارد.
Daily life|Beginner.meaning: the entrance you open to go in or out
Daily life|Beginner.translation: Please close the door, it is cold.

Daily life|Beginner.example: أمي تشتري الخضار من السوق القريب.
Daily life|Beginner.meaning: a place where people buy and sell goods
Daily life|Beginner.translation: My mother buys vegetables at the nearby market.

Daily life|Beginner.example: صباح الخير، كيف حالك اليوم؟
Daily life|Beginner.meaning: the early part of the day
Daily life|Beginner.translation: Good morning, how are you today?

Daily life|Beginner.example: نجلس في الحديقة كل مساء بعد العشاء.
Daily life|Beginner.meaning: the late part of the day, after sunset
Daily life|Beginner.translation: We sit in the garden every evening after dinner.

Daily life|Beginner.example: أحب شرب شاي بالنعناع بعد الغداء.
Daily life|Beginner.meaning: a hot drink made from leaves
Daily life|Beginner.translation: I like drinking mint tea after lunch.

Daily life|Beginner.example: مدرسة أخي قريبة من بيتنا.
Daily life|Beginner.meaning: a place where children go to learn
Daily life|Beginner.translation: My brother's school is close to our house.

Daily life|Beginner.example: سيارة جارنا جديدة ولونها أحمر.
Daily life|Beginner.meaning: a vehicle with four wheels for travelling
Daily life|Beginner.translation: Our neighbour's car is new and red.

Daily life|Beginner.example: أمي تعد الغداء في المطبخ الآن.
Daily life|Beginner.meaning: the room where food is cooked
Daily life|Beginner.translation: My mother is making lunch in the kitchen now.

Daily life|Beginner.example: أنا سعيد جدًا بلقائك اليوم.
Daily life|Beginner.meaning: feeling glad or pleased
Daily life|Beginner.translation: I am very happy to meet you today.

Daily life|Beginner.example: أشعر أنني متعب بعد يوم عمل طويل.
Daily life|Beginner.meaning: feeling that you need rest
Daily life|Beginner.translation: I feel tired after a long day at work.

Daily life|Beginner.example: أخي مريض اليوم ولم يذهب إلى المدرسة.
Daily life|Beginner.meaning: not well, feeling ill
Daily life|Beginner.translation: My brother is sick today and did not go to school.

Daily life|Beginner.example: زار جدي طبيب القلب في المستشفى.
Daily life|Beginner.meaning: a person who treats sick people
Daily life|Beginner.translation: My grandfather saw the heart doctor at the hospital.

Daily life|Beginner.example: المطر يهطل بغزارة منذ الصباح.
Daily life|Beginner.meaning: water that falls from the clouds
Daily life|Beginner.translation: The rain has been pouring down since the morning.

Daily life|Intermediate.example: تناولنا وجبة خفيفة قبل الخروج من البيت.
Daily life|Intermediate.meaning: the food you eat at one sitting
Daily life|Intermediate.translation: We had a light meal before leaving the house.

Daily life|Intermediate.example: دفعت فاتورة الكهرباء في بداية الشهر.
Daily life|Intermediate.meaning: a paper showing money you have to pay
Daily life|Intermediate.translation: I paid the electricity bill at the beginning of the month.

Daily life|Intermediate.example: لدي موعد مع طبيب الأسنان صباح الغد.
Daily life|Intermediate.meaning: a fixed time arranged to meet someone
Daily life|Intermediate.translation: I have an appointment with the dentist tomorrow morning.

Daily life|Intermediate.example: حصلت على خصم كبير على هذا المعطف.
Daily life|Intermediate.meaning: money taken off the normal price
Daily life|Intermediate.translation: I got a big discount on this coat.

Daily life|Intermediate.example: جيران البناية يساعدون بعضهم في كل مناسبة.
Daily life|Intermediate.meaning: the people who live near you
Daily life|Intermediate.translation: The neighbours in the building help each other on every occasion.

Daily life|Intermediate.example: اشترينا أثاث غرفة الجلوس من معرض قريب.
Daily life|Intermediate.meaning: the tables, chairs and beds in a home
Daily life|Intermediate.translation: We bought the living room furniture from a nearby showroom.

Daily life|Intermediate.example: نشرت أمي الغسيل على السطح بعد توقف المطر.
Daily life|Intermediate.meaning: clothes that are being or have been washed
Daily life|Intermediate.translation: My mother hung the laundry out on the roof after the rain stopped.

Daily life|Intermediate.example: نبدأ تنظيف البيت في صباح كل جمعة.
Daily life|Intermediate.meaning: making something free of dirt
Daily life|Intermediate.translation: We start cleaning the house every Friday morning.

Daily life|Intermediate.example: جربت وصفة جديدة لتحضير الكعك أمس.
Daily life|Intermediate.meaning: instructions for cooking a dish
Daily life|Intermediate.translation: I tried a new recipe for making cake yesterday.

Daily life|Intermediate.example: قرأت مقادير الوصفة جيدًا قبل أن أبدأ.
Daily life|Intermediate.meaning: the amounts of each ingredient needed
Daily life|Intermediate.translation: I read the recipe's measurements carefully before I started.

Daily life|Intermediate.example: الصيدلية القريبة من بيتنا مفتوحة طوال الليل.
Daily life|Intermediate.meaning: a shop that sells medicine
Daily life|Intermediate.translation: The pharmacy near our house is open all night.

Daily life|Intermediate.example: ارتفعت درجة حرارة الطفل في منتصف الليل.
Daily life|Intermediate.meaning: how hot something or someone is
Daily life|Intermediate.translation: The child's temperature went up in the middle of the night.

Daily life|Intermediate.example: هذا علاج فعال لآلام الظهر والكتفين.
Daily life|Intermediate.meaning: something used to cure an illness or pain
Daily life|Intermediate.translation: This is an effective treatment for back and shoulder pain.

Daily life|Intermediate.example: أحتاج إلى قسط من الراحة بعد هذا الأسبوع الطويل.
Daily life|Intermediate.meaning: time when you stop working and relax
Daily life|Intermediate.translation: I need some rest after this long week.

Daily life|Intermediate.example: المشي بعد العشاء عادة صحية ممتازة.
Daily life|Intermediate.meaning: something a person does regularly
Daily life|Intermediate.translation: Walking after dinner is an excellent healthy habit.

Daily life|Intermediate.example: لدي روتين ثابت أبدأ به يومي كل صباح.
Daily life|Intermediate.meaning: a fixed set of things done every day
Daily life|Intermediate.translation: I have a fixed routine that I start my day with every morning.

Daily life|Intermediate.example: كان مزاج الجميع رائعًا في رحلة نهاية الأسبوع.
Daily life|Intermediate.meaning: the way someone feels at a given time
Daily life|Intermediate.translation: Everyone was in a great mood on the weekend trip.

Daily life|Intermediate.example: أشعر بقلق بسيط قبل مقابلة العمل غدًا.
Daily life|Intermediate.meaning: an uneasy, nervous feeling
Daily life|Intermediate.translation: I feel a little anxious before the job interview tomorrow.

Daily life|Intermediate.example: الطقس معتدل اليوم ومناسب للنزهة في الحديقة.
Daily life|Intermediate.meaning: the state of the air and sky outside
Daily life|Intermediate.translation: The weather is mild today and good for a walk in the park.

Daily life|Intermediate.example: الرطوبة مرتفعة جدًا في فصل الصيف هنا.
Daily life|Intermediate.meaning: moisture in the air
Daily life|Intermediate.translation: The humidity is very high here in the summer.

IELTS|Advanced.example: يعزى تأخر المشروع إلى نقص التمويل في بدايته.
IELTS|Advanced.meaning: is explained as being caused by something
IELTS|Advanced.translation: The delay of the project is attributed to a lack of funding at its start.

IELTS|Advanced.meaning: real and easy to feel or see
IELTS|Advanced.translation: The improvement in the service has been tangible since the start of the year.

IELTS|Advanced.meaning: a gap between two amounts or levels
IELTS|Advanced.translation: There is a wide gap between rural income and city income.

IELTS|Advanced.example: الفرق بين الرأيين جوهري وليس شكليا.
IELTS|Advanced.meaning: basic and deeply important
IELTS|Advanced.translation: The difference between the two views is fundamental, not merely superficial.

IELTS|Advanced.example: زادت الأجور قليلا، في المقابل ارتفعت الأسعار كثيرا.
IELTS|Advanced.meaning: used to set one fact against another
IELTS|Advanced.translation: Wages went up a little, but in return prices went up a lot.

IELTS|Advanced.example: أحب المدن الهادئة، لا سيما في فصل الربيع.
IELTS|Advanced.meaning: above all, more than the rest
IELTS|Advanced.translation: I love quiet cities, especially in the spring.

IELTS|Advanced.example: من الجدير بالذكر أن المشروع بدأ قبل عامين فقط.
IELTS|Advanced.meaning: used to add a fact worth knowing
IELTS|Advanced.translation: It is worth mentioning that the project started only two years ago.

IELTS|Advanced.example: أسعار المواصلات هنا منخفضة نسبيا مقارنة بالمدن الأخرى.
IELTS|Advanced.meaning: when compared with something else
IELTS|Advanced.translation: Transport prices here are relatively low compared with other cities.

IELTS|Advanced.example: التغير في الأسعار هذا الشهر طفيف جدا.
IELTS|Advanced.meaning: very small in size or effect
IELTS|Advanced.translation: The change in prices this month is very slight.

IELTS|Advanced.example: الانخفاض في المبيعات هذا العام حاد وغير متوقع.
IELTS|Advanced.meaning: sudden and very strong
IELTS|Advanced.translation: The fall in sales this year is sharp and unexpected.

IELTS|Advanced.example: تشهد المدينة ذروة الزحام في ساعات الصباح الأولى.
IELTS|Advanced.meaning: the highest or busiest point
IELTS|Advanced.translation: The city sees the peak of its traffic in the early morning hours.

IELTS|Advanced.example: النمو في عدد المشتركين مضطرد منذ ثلاث سنوات.
IELTS|Advanced.meaning: continuing steadily without stopping
IELTS|Advanced.translation: The growth in the number of subscribers has been steady for three years.

IELTS|Advanced.example: هناك تباين واضح بين آراء الطلاب حول النظام الجديد.
IELTS|Advanced.meaning: a clear difference between things
IELTS|Advanced.translation: There is a clear contrast between the students' views on the new system.

IELTS|Advanced.example: يرجح الخبراء أن تستمر الأسعار في الارتفاع.
IELTS|Advanced.meaning: thinks something is more likely
IELTS|Advanced.translation: Experts think it is likely that prices will keep rising.

IELTS|Advanced.example: لديه حجة قوية تدعم رأيه في هذا الموضوع.
IELTS|Advanced.meaning: a reason given to support a view
IELTS|Advanced.translation: He has a strong argument that supports his view on this subject.

IELTS|Advanced.example: حاول المتحدث دحض كل الاتهامات الموجهة إليه.
IELTS|Advanced.meaning: proving a claim to be wrong
IELTS|Advanced.translation: The speaker tried to refute all the accusations made against him.

IELTS|Advanced.example: في كلامه مبالغة كبيرة، والحقيقة أبسط من ذلك.
IELTS|Advanced.meaning: making something sound bigger than it is
IELTS|Advanced.translation: There is a lot of exaggeration in what he says, and the truth is simpler than that.

IELTS|Advanced.example: أوافقك إلى حد ما، لكن لدي بعض التحفظات.
IELTS|Advanced.meaning: partly, but not completely
IELTS|Advanced.translation: I agree with you to some extent, but I have a few reservations.

IELTS|Advanced.example: يترتب على هذا القرار زيادة في تكاليف النقل.
IELTS|Advanced.meaning: follows as a result of something
IELTS|Advanced.translation: This decision results in an increase in transport costs.

IELTS|Advanced.example: الدراسة عبر الإنترنت أرخص، لكنها من ناحية أخرى تحتاج إلى انضباط أكبر.
IELTS|Advanced.meaning: looking at the opposite side of a matter
IELTS|Advanced.translation: Studying online is cheaper, but on the other hand it requires greater discipline.

IELTS|Beginner.meaning: a rise in amount or number
IELTS|Beginner.translation: We noticed a big increase in the number of students this year.

IELTS|Beginner.example: يظهر الرسم انخفاض أسعار الكهرباء في فصل الشتاء.
IELTS|Beginner.meaning: a fall to a lower level
IELTS|Beginner.translation: The chart shows a drop in electricity prices during the winter.

IELTS|Beginner.example: سبب ارتفاع الأسعار هو قلة المنتجات في السوق.
IELTS|Beginner.meaning: a move to a higher level
IELTS|Beginner.translation: The reason for the rise in prices is the shortage of products in the market.

IELTS|Beginner.example: نسبة النساء في الشركة أعلى من نسبة الرجال.
IELTS|Beginner.meaning: a share or percentage of a total
IELTS|Beginner.translation: The percentage of women in the company is higher than the percentage of men.

IELTS|Beginner.example: عدد السكان في المدينة يزداد كل سنة.
IELTS|Beginner.meaning: how many there are of something
IELTS|Beginner.translation: The number of people living in the city grows every year.

IELTS|Beginner.example: هذا مثال واضح على ما أقصده تماما.
IELTS|Beginner.meaning: one case that shows what you mean
IELTS|Beginner.translation: This is a clear example of exactly what I mean.

IELTS|Beginner.example: سبب تأخري اليوم هو الزحام الشديد في الطريق.
IELTS|Beginner.meaning: the reason something happens
IELTS|Beginner.translation: The reason I was late today is the heavy traffic on the road.

IELTS|Beginner.example: نتيجة الاختبار كانت أفضل مما توقعت.
IELTS|Beginner.meaning: what comes out of something at the end
IELTS|Beginner.translation: The test result was better than I expected.

IELTS|Beginner.example: لكل شخص رأي مختلف في هذه المسألة.
IELTS|Beginner.meaning: what a person thinks about something
IELTS|Beginner.translation: Everyone has a different opinion on this issue.

IELTS|Beginner.example: هناك مشكلة كبيرة في نظام النقل العام.
IELTS|Beginner.meaning: something difficult that needs fixing
IELTS|Beginner.translation: There is a big problem with the public transport system.

IELTS|Beginner.example: الحل الوحيد هو تقليل استخدام السيارات في المدينة.
IELTS|Beginner.meaning: a way to fix a problem
IELTS|Beginner.translation: The only solution is to reduce the use of cars in the city.

IELTS|Beginner.example: الفرق بين الصورتين واضح جدا.
IELTS|Beginner.meaning: the way two things are not the same
IELTS|Beginner.translation: The difference between the two pictures is very clear.

IELTS|Beginner.example: بالمقارنة مع العام الماضي، تحسنت النتائج كثيرا.
IELTS|Beginner.meaning: looking at two things side by side
IELTS|Beginner.translation: Compared with last year, the results have improved a lot.

IELTS|Beginner.example: الناس اليوم يستخدمون الهاتف أكثر من التلفاز.
IELTS|Beginner.meaning: a larger amount than something else
IELTS|Beginner.translation: People today use the phone more than the television.

IELTS|Beginner.example: أسعار الملابس في الصيف أقل من أسعارها في الشتاء.
IELTS|Beginner.meaning: a smaller amount than something else
IELTS|Beginner.translation: Clothes prices in summer are lower than they are in winter.

IELTS|Beginner.example: تغير الطقس فجأة بعد الظهر.
IELTS|Beginner.meaning: to become different
IELTS|Beginner.translation: The weather changed suddenly in the afternoon.

IELTS|Beginner.example: من المهم أن تنام جيدا قبل الامتحان.
IELTS|Beginner.meaning: of great value or worth caring about
IELTS|Beginner.translation: It is important to sleep well before the exam.

IELTS|Beginner.example: ربما نسافر إلى البحر في نهاية الأسبوع.
IELTS|Beginner.meaning: possibly, but not for sure
IELTS|Beginner.translation: Maybe we will travel to the sea at the weekend.

IELTS|Beginner.example: أحب القراءة، وأحب الكتابة أيضا.
IELTS|Beginner.meaning: as well, in addition
IELTS|Beginner.translation: I love reading, and I love writing too.

IELTS|Beginner.example: لم أدرس جيدا، لذلك لم أنجح في الامتحان.
IELTS|Beginner.meaning: for that reason
IELTS|Beginner.translation: I did not study well, so I did not pass the exam.

IELTS|Intermediate.example: يوضح الجدول عدد الزوار في كل شهر.
IELTS|Intermediate.meaning: makes something clear or shows it
IELTS|Intermediate.translation: The table shows the number of visitors in each month.

IELTS|Intermediate.example: يشير التقرير إلى تحسن كبير في الخدمات الصحية.
IELTS|Intermediate.translation: The report points to a major improvement in health services.

IELTS|Intermediate.example: ارتفع عدد الطلاب في المدن، بينما انخفض في القرى.
IELTS|Intermediate.meaning: at the same time as, or in contrast
IELTS|Intermediate.translation: The number of students rose in the cities, while it fell in the villages.

IELTS|Intermediate.example: بعض المدن تعاني من التلوث، على سبيل المثال القاهرة وبكين.
IELTS|Intermediate.translation: Some cities suffer from pollution, for example Cairo and Beijing.

IELTS|Intermediate.example: بالإضافة إلى الراتب، تقدم الشركة تأمينا صحيا لموظفيها.
IELTS|Intermediate.translation: In addition to the salary, the company offers health insurance to its employees.

IELTS|Intermediate.example: على الرغم من التعب، أكمل عمله حتى المساء.
IELTS|Intermediate.translation: Despite being tired, he carried on with his work until the evening.

IELTS|Intermediate.example: استغرقت الرحلة ساعتين تقريبا.
IELTS|Intermediate.meaning: close to an amount, but not exactly
IELTS|Intermediate.translation: The trip took about two hours.

IELTS|Intermediate.example: معدل درجات الحرارة في الصيف مرتفع جدا هنا.
IELTS|Intermediate.meaning: the usual or middle level of something
IELTS|Intermediate.translation: The average temperature in summer is very high here.

IELTS|Intermediate.example: تطور استخدام الإنترنت بسرعة في السنوات الأخيرة.
IELTS|Intermediate.translation: The use of the internet has developed quickly in recent years.

IELTS|Intermediate.example: شهد السوق حالة من الاستقرار خلال الشهر الماضي.
IELTS|Intermediate.translation: The market saw a period of stability during the past month.

IELTS|Intermediate.example: تراجع عدد القراء بعد انتشار الهواتف الذكية.
IELTS|Intermediate.translation: The number of readers declined after smartphones became widespread.

IELTS|Intermediate.example: ساعد انتشار الإنترنت على تسهيل التعليم عن بعد.
IELTS|Intermediate.meaning: spreading widely among people or places
IELTS|Intermediate.translation: The spread of the internet has made distance learning easier.

IELTS|Intermediate.example: هناك تحسن ملحوظ في مستوى ابني هذا الفصل.
IELTS|Intermediate.meaning: big enough to be easily seen
IELTS|Intermediate.translation: There is a noticeable improvement in my son's level this term.

IELTS|Intermediate.example: تحسنت حالته الصحية تدريجيا بعد العملية.
IELTS|Intermediate.translation: His health improved gradually after the operation.

IELTS|Intermediate.example: بشكل عام، الحياة في القرية أهدأ من الحياة في المدينة.
IELTS|Intermediate.translation: In general, life in the village is quieter than life in the city.

IELTS|Intermediate.example: للنوم الجيد تأثير كبير على التركيز في الصباح.
IELTS|Intermediate.meaning: the effect one thing has on another
IELTS|Intermediate.translation: Good sleep has a big effect on concentration in the morning.

IELTS|Intermediate.example: هذا الرقم دليل واضح على نجاح الخطة.
IELTS|Intermediate.translation: This figure is clear proof that the plan has succeeded.

IELTS|Intermediate.example: هناك اتجاه عام نحو استخدام السيارات الكهربائية.
IELTS|Intermediate.meaning: the direction things are moving in
IELTS|Intermediate.translation: There is a general trend towards using electric cars.

IELTS|Intermediate.example: يتوقع الخبراء ارتفاع الأسعار خلال الشهر القادم.
IELTS|Intermediate.translation: Experts expect prices to rise during the coming month.

IELTS|Intermediate.example: الأغلبية تفضل العمل من المنزل يومين في الأسبوع.
IELTS|Intermediate.meaning: most of a group of people
IELTS|Intermediate.translation: The majority prefer to work from home two days a week.

Travel|Advanced.example: قضينا ثلاث عشرة ساعة على متن الطائرة.
Travel|Advanced.meaning: on board a plane, ship or train
Travel|Advanced.translation: We spent thirteen hours on board the plane.

Travel|Advanced.example: يعيش حياة ترحال لا تعرف الاستقرار.
Travel|Advanced.meaning: constant moving from place to place
Travel|Advanced.translation: He lives a wandering life that never settles down.

Travel|Advanced.example: زرنا أهم معالم المدينة في يوم واحد.
Travel|Advanced.meaning: the famous sights of a place
Travel|Advanced.translation: We visited the city's most important landmarks in a single day.

Travel|Advanced.example: يحتاج دخول المحمية إلى تصريح خاص.
Travel|Advanced.meaning: official written permission to do something
Travel|Advanced.translation: Entering the nature reserve requires a special permit.

Travel|Advanced.example: استغرقت إجراءات المغادرة وقتا أطول من المتوقع.
Travel|Advanced.meaning: the official steps you have to go through
Travel|Advanced.translation: The departure formalities took longer than expected.

Travel|Advanced.example: خضعت الحقائب إلى تفتيش دقيق قبل الصعود.
Travel|Advanced.meaning: a careful search or inspection
Travel|Advanced.translation: The bags went through a thorough inspection before boarding.

Travel|Advanced.example: وضع الموظف ختم الدخول على جوازي.
Travel|Advanced.meaning: an official mark pressed onto a document
Travel|Advanced.translation: The officer put the entry stamp in my passport.

Travel|Advanced.example: صارت هذه القرية الجبلية مقصد المصورين من كل مكان.
Travel|Advanced.meaning: a place people deliberately travel to
Travel|Advanced.translation: This mountain village has become a magnet for photographers from everywhere.

Travel|Advanced.example: هذا تذكار بسيط اشتريته من سوق مراكش.
Travel|Advanced.meaning: an object kept to remember a place by
Travel|Advanced.translation: This is a simple souvenir I bought in the Marrakesh market.

Travel|Advanced.example: نفضل استكشاف الأحياء القديمة سيرا على الأقدام.
Travel|Advanced.meaning: going around a place to discover it
Travel|Advanced.translation: We prefer exploring the old neighbourhoods on foot.

Travel|Advanced.example: ضللنا الطريق في زقاق ضيق لا يتسع لسيارة.
Travel|Advanced.meaning: a very narrow lane between buildings
Travel|Advanced.translation: We lost our way in a narrow alley too tight for a car.

Travel|Advanced.example: طلبت من مضيفة الطيران كوب ماء بارد.
Travel|Advanced.meaning: a woman who looks after passengers on a plane
Travel|Advanced.translation: I asked the flight attendant for a glass of cold water.

Travel|Advanced.example: حذر الكابتن الركاب من اضطراب جوي مفاجئ.
Travel|Advanced.meaning: rough air that shakes a plane in flight
Travel|Advanced.translation: The captain warned the passengers about sudden turbulence.

Travel|Advanced.example: تختلف لوائح الدخول من دولة إلى أخرى.
Travel|Advanced.meaning: official rules and regulations
Travel|Advanced.translation: Entry regulations differ from one country to another.

Travel|Advanced.example: يعد ابن بطوطة أشهر رحالة عربي في التاريخ.
Travel|Advanced.meaning: someone famous for travelling far and wide
Travel|Advanced.translation: Ibn Battuta is regarded as the most famous Arab traveller in history.

Travel|Advanced.example: كتب مذكراته عن أسفار دامت عشرين عاما.
Travel|Advanced.meaning: long journeys, especially many of them
Travel|Advanced.translation: He wrote his memoirs about travels that lasted twenty years.

Travel|Advanced.example: يشمل السعر مبيت ليلة واحدة مع الإفطار.
Travel|Advanced.meaning: staying somewhere overnight
Travel|Advanced.translation: The price includes one night's stay with breakfast.

Travel|Advanced.example: أمضينا الليلة في نزل ريفي بسيط.
Travel|Advanced.meaning: a small, simple place to stay for the night
Travel|Advanced.translation: We spent the night in a simple country inn.

Travel|Advanced.example: أنا مجرد زائر عابر في هذه المدينة.
Travel|Advanced.meaning: passing through for only a short time
Travel|Advanced.translation: I am only a passing visitor in this city.

Travel|Advanced.example: خضع القادمون إلى حجر صحي لمدة أسبوع.
Travel|Advanced.meaning: being kept apart to stop a disease spreading
Travel|Advanced.translation: The arrivals were placed in quarantine for a week.

Travel|Beginner.example: تقلع طائرتنا من مطار القاهرة في السابعة صباحا.
Travel|Beginner.meaning: a place where planes take off and land
Travel|Beginner.translation: Our plane takes off from Cairo airport at seven in the morning.

Travel|Beginner.example: ركبنا طائرة كبيرة ووصلنا بعد ثلاث ساعات.
Travel|Beginner.meaning: a flying machine that carries people
Travel|Beginner.translation: We boarded a big plane and arrived three hours later.

Travel|Beginner.example: حجزنا غرفة في فندق قريب من المحطة.
Travel|Beginner.meaning: a place where travellers pay to stay
Travel|Beginner.translation: We booked a room in a hotel near the station.

Travel|Beginner.example: أريد غرفة لشخصين لمدة ثلاث ليال من فضلك.
Travel|Beginner.meaning: a space inside a building with walls and a door
Travel|Beginner.translation: I would like a room for two people for three nights, please.

Travel|Beginner.example: أحمل حقيبة ثقيلة على ظهري.
Travel|Beginner.meaning: a bag for carrying your things
Travel|Beginner.translation: I am carrying a heavy bag on my back.

Travel|Beginner.example: هل معك جواز سفر ساري المفعول؟
Travel|Beginner.meaning: an official document that lets you travel abroad
Travel|Beginner.translation: Do you have a valid passport with you?

Travel|Beginner.example: اشتريت تذكرة ذهاب وعودة بسعر جيد.
Travel|Beginner.meaning: a paper you buy to travel or to enter somewhere
Travel|Beginner.translation: I bought a return ticket at a good price.

Travel|Beginner.example: هذا طريق طويل لكنه جميل جدا.
Travel|Beginner.meaning: a way or road that leads from one place to another
Travel|Beginner.translation: This is a long road, but it is very beautiful.

Travel|Beginner.example: كانت رحلة ممتعة ولم نشعر بالتعب.
Travel|Beginner.meaning: a journey from one place to another
Travel|Beginner.translation: It was an enjoyable trip and we did not feel tired.

Travel|Beginner.example: زرنا مدينة قديمة فيها أسواق جميلة.
Travel|Beginner.meaning: a large place where many people live and work
Travel|Beginner.translation: We visited an old city with beautiful markets.

Travel|Beginner.example: فندقنا يقع في شارع هادئ قرب البحر.
Travel|Beginner.meaning: a road in a town with buildings along it
Travel|Beginner.translation: Our hotel is on a quiet street near the sea.

Travel|Beginner.example: أخذنا سيارة أجرة من المطار إلى الفندق.
Travel|Beginner.meaning: a car you pay to drive you somewhere
Travel|Beginner.translation: We took a taxi from the airport to the hotel.

Travel|Beginner.example: ركبنا قطار الصباح إلى الإسكندرية.
Travel|Beginner.meaning: a long vehicle that runs on rails
Travel|Beginner.translation: We took the morning train to Alexandria.

Travel|Beginner.example: تنطلق حافلة أخرى إلى وسط المدينة بعد قليل.
Travel|Beginner.meaning: a big road vehicle that carries many passengers
Travel|Beginner.translation: Another bus leaves for the city centre shortly.

Travel|Beginner.example: نزلنا في محطة صغيرة قرب السوق.
Travel|Beginner.meaning: a place where trains or buses stop for passengers
Travel|Beginner.translation: We got off at a small station near the market.

Travel|Beginner.example: أخرجت خريطة صغيرة لأعرف مكاننا.
Travel|Beginner.meaning: a drawing that shows places and roads
Travel|Beginner.translation: I took out a small map to work out where we were.

Travel|Beginner.example: غرفتنا تطل على بحر أزرق صاف.
Travel|Beginner.meaning: a very large area of salt water
Travel|Beginner.translation: Our room looks out over a clear blue sea.

Travel|Beginner.example: قضينا العصر على شاطئ هادئ.
Travel|Beginner.meaning: the strip of sand or stones beside the sea
Travel|Beginner.translation: We spent the afternoon on a quiet beach.

Travel|Beginner.example: أعطاني الموظف مفتاح الغرفة رقم عشرين.
Travel|Beginner.meaning: a small metal object that opens a lock
Travel|Beginner.translation: The clerk gave me the key to room twenty.

Travel|Beginner.example: عندي حجز باسم سامي منذ الأسبوع الماضي.
Travel|Beginner.meaning: an arrangement made in advance to keep a place for you
Travel|Beginner.translation: I have a booking under the name Sami from last week.

Travel|Intermediate.example: ننتظر في صالة المغادرة منذ ساعتين.
Travel|Intermediate.meaning: the airport hall where passengers wait to leave
Travel|Intermediate.translation: We have been waiting in the departure lounge for two hours.

Travel|Intermediate.example: تغيرت بوابة الصعود في اللحظة الأخيرة.
Travel|Intermediate.meaning: the airport door where you get on the plane
Travel|Intermediate.translation: The boarding gate changed at the last minute.

Travel|Intermediate.example: حصلت على تأشيرة سياحية لمدة شهر.
Travel|Intermediate.meaning: official permission to enter a country
Travel|Intermediate.translation: I got a tourist visa for one month.

Travel|Intermediate.example: يشمل العرض إقامة كاملة مع الإفطار.
Travel|Intermediate.meaning: a stay in a place for a period of time
Travel|Intermediate.translation: The offer includes full accommodation with breakfast.

Travel|Intermediate.example: أصبحت هذه الجزيرة وجهة مفضلة للعائلات.
Travel|Intermediate.meaning: the place you are travelling to
Travel|Intermediate.translation: This island has become a favourite destination for families.

Travel|Intermediate.example: حدث تأخير طويل بسبب سوء الأحوال الجوية.
Travel|Intermediate.meaning: when something happens later than planned
Travel|Intermediate.translation: There was a long delay because of the bad weather.

Travel|Intermediate.example: تأجل إقلاع الطائرة ساعة كاملة.
Travel|Intermediate.meaning: the moment a plane leaves the ground
Travel|Intermediate.translation: The plane's takeoff was put back by a whole hour.

Travel|Intermediate.example: كان هبوط الطائرة سلسا رغم الرياح.
Travel|Intermediate.meaning: when a plane comes down onto the ground
Travel|Intermediate.translation: The plane's landing was smooth despite the wind.

Travel|Intermediate.example: ضاعت أمتعة بعض الركاب في المطار.
Travel|Intermediate.meaning: the bags and cases you travel with
Travel|Intermediate.translation: Some passengers' luggage was lost at the airport.

Travel|Intermediate.example: مررنا على جمارك المطار من دون مشاكل.
Travel|Intermediate.meaning: the office that checks goods crossing a border
Travel|Intermediate.translation: We went through airport customs without any problems.

Travel|Intermediate.example: أمامي مسافر يحمل حقيبتين ثقيلتين.
Travel|Intermediate.meaning: a person who is making a journey
Travel|Intermediate.translation: In front of me is a traveller carrying two heavy bags.

Travel|Intermediate.example: اسأل موظف استقبال الفندق عن أقرب صيدلية.
Travel|Intermediate.meaning: the desk that welcomes and helps guests
Travel|Intermediate.translation: Ask the hotel reception clerk about the nearest pharmacy.

Travel|Intermediate.example: لدينا توقف قصير في إسطنبول قبل الرحلة الثانية.
Travel|Intermediate.meaning: a short break in the middle of a journey
Travel|Intermediate.translation: We have a short stopover in Istanbul before the second flight.

Travel|Intermediate.example: سرنا في اتجاه خاطئ عشر دقائق.
Travel|Intermediate.meaning: the way something faces or moves
Travel|Intermediate.translation: We walked in the wrong direction for ten minutes.

Travel|Intermediate.example: حجزنا جولة سياحية في المدينة القديمة.
Travel|Intermediate.meaning: a short organised trip around a place
Travel|Intermediate.translation: We booked a sightseeing tour of the old city.

Travel|Intermediate.example: لا تنس شراء تأمين السفر قبل المغادرة.
Travel|Intermediate.meaning: a policy that covers problems during a trip
Travel|Intermediate.translation: Do not forget to buy travel insurance before you leave.

Travel|Intermediate.example: يوجد مكتب صرف العملات في الطابق الأرضي.
Travel|Intermediate.meaning: changing money from one currency into another
Travel|Intermediate.translation: There is a currency exchange office on the ground floor.

Travel|Intermediate.example: سأل سائق التاكسي عن عنوان الفندق.
Travel|Intermediate.meaning: a person who drives a vehicle
Travel|Intermediate.translation: The taxi driver asked for the hotel address.

Travel|Intermediate.example: كان هناك زحام شديد في الطريق إلى المطار.
Travel|Intermediate.meaning: too many people or cars crowded in one place
Travel|Intermediate.translation: There was heavy traffic on the way to the airport.

Travel|Intermediate.example: تم إلغاء الرحلة بسبب العاصفة.
Travel|Intermediate.meaning: calling off something that was planned
Travel|Intermediate.translation: The flight was cancelled because of the storm.
